title: Upgrading Your Rods
description: Once you've gotten a good grip on fishing, you might want to think about upgrading that rod of yours. Doing so is real simple. [Just take your rod and pop it into a smithing table along with the new material, like iron, gold, or diamond, and a bit of string.](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/rod_upgrade.png:124:38:4:1000) If you're upgrading to a stronger tier, you can use any kind of fishing rod from a lower tier, so something like a diamond rod can be upgraded from a normal rod, a gold rod, or an iron rod.
